desc: The R7 is the binocular hunters reach for when they need one optic capable of doing it all. From whitetails in the hardwoods to elk in the mountains and antelope on the prairie, it delivers the ideal balance of magnification, field of view, and portability for virtually any pursuit. With ED Prime Glass, field-flattener optics, and a rugged magnesium chassis, the R7 provides the clarity, comfort, and reliability hunters depend on season after season. Ready. Rugged. Reliable
